selection_basis: Original sensitivity study: lower position/velocity RMSE and greater compliance than warning0.8 at comparable laser use. Choose only warning; no joint retuning.
scope: New optimization seeds on the same eight physical scenes and shared Monte Carlo inputs. This is not validation on new geometry or independent truth draws. No further 96-target runs; previous overload evidence remains archived and in Appendix C/replies.
decision_rule: Report all120 runs and both controls, even if the selected variant is worse. Do not change candidate based on validation outcomes.
